name: raman-studio
description: Desktop electrochemical analysis — EIS, CV, GCD, supercapacitor — by VidyuthLabs

scripts.dev: npm run build:renderer && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:win: npm run build:renderer && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:renderer && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:renderer && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
